title: Rule-based and reinforcement-learning policies for resource allocation in a pediatric echo lab: a simulation study
abstract: arXiv:2506.06297v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Scheduling echocardiographic examinations in a hospital setting presents significant challenges due to non-deterministic factors such as patient no-shows, variable arrival times, and heterogeneous exam durations, as well as asymmetric resource constraints between fetal and non-fetal patient streams. Fetal cases involve specialized ultrasound examinations performed during pregnancy, whereas non-fetal cases correspond to general diagnostic echocardiography services. Using one week (184 patients) of operational data from the Echo Laboratory at Stanford University's Lucile Packard Children's Hospital, we estimate patient no-show probabilities and derive empirical distributions of arrival times and exam durations, and use them to build a discrete-event stochastic simulation model using SimPy, exposed through an open-source Gymnasium interface (https://github.com/desResLab/echo_rl). translated_title: 儿科超声心动图实验室资源分配的基于规则的策略与强化学习策略：一项仿真研究
translated_abstract: 在医院环境中安排超声心动图检查面临重大挑战，其原因包括患者爽约、到达时间多变、检查时长异质等非确定性因素，以及胎儿与非胎儿患者流之间不对称的资源约束。胎儿病例涉及孕期进行的专门超声检查，而非胎儿病例对应常规诊断性超声心动图服务。利用斯坦福大学Lucile Packard儿童医院超声心动图实验室一周（184名患者）的运营数据，我们估计了患者爽约概率，并推导出到达时间和检查时长的经验分布，进而使用SimPy构建了一个离散事件随机仿真模型，并通过开源的Gymnasium接口对外提供（https://github.com/desResLab/echo_rl）。作为策略优化的基线，我们系统地……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该研究基于斯坦福儿童医院一周的真实运营数据，构建了儿科超声心动图实验室的离散事件随机仿真模型并通过开源Gymnasium接口提供，为基于规则和强化学习的资源分配策略优化提供了可复现的实验平台。
en_tdlr: Using one week of real operational data from a pediatric echo lab, this study builds a discrete-event stochastic simulation model exposed via an open-source Gymnasium interface, enabling optimization and comparison of rule-based and reinforcement-learning resource allocation policies.
